notes: The source test builds MrpackManifest JSON via a shared 'manifest(dependencies:name:)' helper: {formatVersion:1, game:"minecraft", versionId:"43", name, dependencies, files:[]} — 'manifest' here is that fully-assembled shape, not just the varied dependencies/name the test passes to the helper. A dependencies block with a loader but NO 'minecraft' key at all — .versionEntry must be nil (there's no MC version to pin a picker entry to), even though the loader flavor/version themselves would still resolve.
